description: Cancels a booked visit when the person asks and confirms in this conversation, free under the shop's own terms: within 3 days of booking, and before the visit; nothing is owed. Side effects: the visit comes off the shop's schedule, and the shop texts the person that their assistant cancelled it. It cannot be undone here: to book again, get a new quote. Past those terms the person calls the shop. Calling again sends no second text.

quote_id.description: The quote_id find_help or get_quote gave, for a booked visit.

name: cancel_booking

change.description: A change the person's assistant asked for once booked: a cancel (done at once, free under the shop's terms), or a move (the shop texted the person a link, and done once they picked a new time).

visit.description: The booked visit as it stands now: its time, its tech, and what has happened since the yes.

now.description: Where the visit has got to, from the tech's own taps and the visit's close.

promise.description: The time promised now, and how the arrival measured against it: open (its time has not ended), kept (arrived inside it), early or late (by minutes), missed, canceled, or unrecorded.

title: Cancel the visit
